text: RAMS Global, the below-back-number sponsor of Fenerbahce's BSL shirts, is a construction and real-estate brand of Turkey's RAMS Holding; its announcement was carried by BasketFaul, which describes the company's placement on the club's shirts for the 2025/26 season onward.
short: RAMS Global is a brand of Turkey's RAMS Holding.

source.name: BasketFaul - RAMS Global, Fenerbahce'ye sponsor
source.quote: RAMS Global Logosu; ... Türkiye Basketbol Süper Ligi maçlarında giyeceği formalarının sırt numara altında
